CLMT.name: Calumet
CLMT.english: Calumet manufactures specialty products for consumer and industrial markets and produces renewable fuels through Montana Renewables.
CLMT.chinese: Calumet 为消费与工业市场制造特种产品，并通过 Montana Renewables 生产可再生燃料。

META.name: Meta Platforms
META.english: Meta operates Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp and develops technologies for social connection and digital experiences.
META.chinese: Meta 运营 Facebook、Instagram 和 WhatsApp，并开发用于社交连接与数字体验的技术。

GME.name: GameStop
GME.english: GameStop sells video games, consoles, accessories and collectibles through stores and online channels, including pre-owned products and trade-ins.
GME.chinese: GameStop 通过门店和线上渠道销售电子游戏、游戏机、配件与收藏品，并提供二手商品及回收换购服务。

GOOGL.name: Alphabet
GOOGL.english: Alphabet is the parent of Google. Its businesses include internet services, advertising, YouTube, cloud computing and other technology ventures.
GOOGL.chinese: Alphabet 是谷歌的母公司，业务包括互联网服务、广告、YouTube、云计算及其他科技业务。

GOOG.name: Alphabet
GOOG.english: Alphabet is the parent of Google. Its businesses include internet services, advertising, YouTube, cloud computing and other technology ventures.
GOOG.chinese: Alphabet 是谷歌的母公司，业务包括互联网服务、广告、YouTube、云计算及其他科技业务。

NBIS.name: Nebius
NBIS.english: Nebius provides cloud infrastructure for AI development, training and inference.
NBIS.chinese: Nebius 提供面向人工智能开发、训练与推理的云基础设施。

IREN.name: IREN
IREN.english: IREN develops and operates data centers and supplies cloud computing infrastructure for AI and high-performance workloads.
IREN.chinese: IREN 开发与运营数据中心，并为人工智能和高性能计算提供云计算基础设施。

MRNA.name: Moderna
MRNA.english: Moderna develops messenger RNA medicines and vaccines for disease prevention and treatment.
MRNA.chinese: Moderna 开发用于疾病预防与治疗的信使 RNA 药物及疫苗。

FCEL.name: FuelCell Energy
FCEL.english: FuelCell Energy develops fuel-cell platforms for power generation, combined heat and power, hydrogen and carbon capture.
FCEL.chinese: FuelCell Energy 开发燃料电池平台，应用于发电、热电联产、制氢及碳捕集。

MRVL.name: Marvell Technology
MRVL.english: Marvell develops data infrastructure semiconductors for computing, networking and storage.
MRVL.chinese: Marvell 开发用于计算、网络及存储的数据基础设施半导体产品。

SNOW.name: Snowflake
SNOW.english: Snowflake provides a cloud data platform for data engineering, analytics, AI applications and collaboration.
SNOW.chinese: Snowflake 提供云数据平台，支持数据工程、分析、人工智能应用及数据协作。

TEM.name: Tempus AI
TEM.english: Tempus uses AI and clinical and molecular data to support precision medicine, diagnostics and research.
TEM.chinese: Tempus 利用人工智能、临床与分子数据，支持精准医疗、诊断及研究。

AVGO.name: Broadcom
AVGO.english: Broadcom designs and supplies semiconductor products and infrastructure software for networking, connectivity and enterprise computing.
AVGO.chinese: 博通设计与提供用于网络、连接和企业计算的半导体产品及基础设施软件。

CIFR.name: Cipher Digital
CIFR.english: Cipher Digital develops and operates industrial-scale data centers for high-performance computing workloads.
CIFR.chinese: Cipher Digital 开发与运营面向高性能计算工作负载的大规模数据中心。

INTC.name: Intel
INTC.english: Intel designs and manufactures processors and computing platforms and provides semiconductor foundry and packaging services.
INTC.chinese: 英特尔设计与制造处理器和计算平台，并提供半导体代工及封装服务。

IONQ.name: IonQ
IONQ.english: IonQ develops quantum computing systems and related technology for commercial and research applications.
IONQ.chinese: IonQ 开发量子计算系统及相关技术，面向商业和科研应用。

AAOI.name: Applied Optoelectronics
AAOI.english: Applied Optoelectronics develops lasers, optical transceivers and broadband access products for communications networks.
AAOI.chinese: Applied Optoelectronics 开发用于通信网络的激光器、光收发模块和宽带接入产品。

HROW.name: Harrow
HROW.english: Harrow develops and commercializes ophthalmic pharmaceuticals for eye-care professionals and their patients.
HROW.chinese: Harrow 开发与商业化眼科药品，服务眼科医疗专业人员及患者。

QQQ.name: Invesco QQQ ETF
QQQ.english: Invesco QQQ tracks the Nasdaq-100 Index, which includes large non-financial companies listed on Nasdaq. It is a fund, not an operating company.
QQQ.chinese: Invesco QQQ 跟踪纳斯达克 100 指数，覆盖在纳斯达克上市的大型非金融公司。它是基金，而非经营性公司。

TQQQ.name: ProShares UltraPro QQQ
TQQQ.english: TQQQ seeks three times the daily performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index before fees and expenses. Compounding means returns over longer periods can differ substantially from three times the index return.
TQQQ.chinese: TQQQ 力求在扣除费用前实现纳斯达克 100 指数每日表现的三倍。由于复利效应，更长时间的回报可能明显偏离指数同期回报的三倍。

XLK.name: Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF
XLK.english: XLK seeks to track the Technology Select Sector Index, providing exposure to the technology sector of the S&P 500.
XLK.chinese: XLK 力求跟踪科技精选行业指数，提供对标普 500 科技行业公司的投资敞口。

NFLX.name: Netflix
NFLX.english: Netflix provides entertainment services including television series, films and games.
NFLX.chinese: Netflix 提供包括剧集、电影及游戏在内的娱乐服务。

COIN.name: Coinbase
COIN.english: Coinbase provides cryptocurrency trading and related financial infrastructure for individuals and institutions.
COIN.chinese: Coinbase 为个人及机构提供加密货币交易和相关金融基础设施。

CRCL.name: Circle Internet Group
CRCL.english: Circle provides stablecoins, including USDC and EURC, and infrastructure for digital payments and financial applications.
CRCL.chinese: Circle 提供 USDC、EURC 等稳定币，以及数字支付与金融应用基础设施。

CRWV.name: CoreWeave
CRWV.english: CoreWeave provides cloud infrastructure designed for AI workloads, including GPU computing, storage and orchestration.
CRWV.chinese: CoreWeave 提供面向人工智能工作负载的云基础设施，包括 GPU 计算、存储及编排服务。

APP.name: AppLovin
APP.english: AppLovin provides advertising technology to help businesses acquire customers and monetize digital products.
APP.chinese: AppLovin 提供广告技术，帮助企业获取客户并实现数字产品的商业化。

ARM.name: Arm Holdings
ARM.english: Arm develops processor architectures, intellectual property and computing platforms used across mobile devices, data centers and embedded systems.
ARM.chinese: Arm 开发处理器架构、知识产权及计算平台，应用于移动设备、数据中心及嵌入式系统。

CRWD.name: CrowdStrike
CRWD.english: CrowdStrike provides the cloud-native Falcon cybersecurity platform for endpoint, cloud and identity protection.
CRWD.chinese: CrowdStrike 提供云原生 Falcon 网络安全平台，用于终端、云及身份防护。

LITE.name: Lumentum
LITE.english: Lumentum develops optical and photonic products for communications networks and commercial laser applications.
LITE.chinese: Lumentum 开发用于通信网络及商业激光应用的光学和光子产品。

ORCL.name: Oracle
ORCL.english: Oracle supplies database technology, cloud infrastructure and enterprise applications.
ORCL.chinese: 甲骨文提供数据库技术、云基础设施及企业应用软件。

SMCI.name: Super Micro Computer
SMCI.english: Supermicro develops server, storage and computing systems for data centers, AI and cloud applications.
SMCI.chinese: Supermicro 开发面向数据中心、人工智能和云应用的服务器、存储及计算系统。

SOFI.name: SoFi Technologies
SOFI.english: SoFi provides financial services including lending, banking and investing through a digital platform.
SOFI.chinese: SoFi 通过数字平台提供贷款、银行及投资等金融服务。

RDDT.name: Reddit
RDDT.english: Reddit is a platform of online communities organized around interests, discussions and shared content.
RDDT.chinese: Reddit 是由线上社区组成的平台，围绕不同兴趣开展讨论与内容分享。

TSM.name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing
TSM.english: TSMC provides dedicated semiconductor foundry services, manufacturing chips designed by its customers.
TSM.chinese: 台积电提供专业半导体代工服务，为客户制造其设计的芯片。

SMH.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
SMH.english: SMH seeks to track an index of semiconductor and semiconductor equipment companies.
SMH.chinese: SMH 力求跟踪由半导体及半导体设备公司构成的指数。
